ticker_news.title: Meta Just Signed a $27 Billion Artificial Intelligence (AI) Deal. Here's the Under-the-Radar Stock That Won.
ticker_news.description: Meta announced a $27 billion capacity deal with neocloud provider Nebius Group to secure access to Nvidia's Vera Rubin GPU architecture across multiple data centers. The deal, which includes $12 billion in committed capacity and $15 billion in optional capacity, allows Meta to diversify its AI infrastructure supply chain while avoiding full capital burdens of building data centers internally. Nebius, which also has partnerships with Microsoft ($19.4B) and Nvidia ($2B investment), is positioned as a critical supplier in the undersupplied AI compute market.
ticker_news.author: Adam Spatacco
